# Data Dictionary

Canonical column-level reference for the warehouse. Source-system columns
are documented here too; the Bronze layer keeps source naming, Silver
normalises, Gold uses the names below.

## Conventions

* `*_sk` columns are surrogate keys (BIGINT, generated by Synapse sequences).
* `*_bk` columns are business / natural keys carried over from the source.
* Date keys (`*_date_sk`) are integers in `YYYYMMDD` form; join to `dim_date.date_sk`.
* Money columns are `DECIMAL(12,2)` unless they aggregate, in which case `DECIMAL(14,2)`.
* All clinical values use SI / metric units: temperatures in °C, weights in kg.
* Currency: bills are stored in EGP for the local hospital network. Synthea
  cost columns arrive in USD and are converted in Silver using the FX rate
  effective on the encounter date.

## Dimensions

### dim_date

| Column            | Type      | Notes |
|-------------------|-----------|-------|
| date_sk           | INT (PK)  | YYYYMMDD form. |
| calendar_date     | DATE      | Local civil date. |
| year, quarter, month, day_of_month | INT |  |
| month_name, day_name | NVARCHAR(20) | Long form, English. |
| iso_week          | INT       | ISO 8601 week-of-year. |
| is_weekend        | BIT       | 1 for Sat/Sun. |
| is_month_start    | BIT       | 1 if `day_of_month = 1`. |
| month_end_date    | DATE      | EOMONTH of `calendar_date`. |
| quarter_start_date| DATE      | First date of the quarter. |

### dim_patient (SCD2)

| Column          | Type            | Notes |
|-----------------|-----------------|-------|
| patient_sk      | BIGINT (PK)     | Surrogate. |
| patient_bk      | UNIQUEIDENTIFIER| Source patient_id. |
| mrn             | VARCHAR(20)     | Medical Record Number. Stable per patient. |
| first_name, last_name | NVARCHAR(80) |  |
| full_name       | NVARCHAR(160)   | Computed `first + ' ' + last`. |
| date_of_birth   | DATE            |  |
| age_band        | VARCHAR(20)     | One of: `0-17`, `18-34`, `35-49`, `50-64`, `65-79`, `80+`. Computed at load time from DOB. |
| gender          | CHAR(1)         | `M`, `F`, `U`. |
| marital_status  | VARCHAR(20)     | `S`, `M`, `D`, `W` or null. |
| race, ethnicity | NVARCHAR(60)    | Free-text from Synthea. |
| governorate, city | NVARCHAR(80) | Egyptian governorate after Silver remap. |
| is_deceased     | BIT             | 1 if Synthea provided `DEATHDATE`. |
| effective_from, effective_to, is_current | datetime / bit | SCD2 metadata. |
| record_hash     | CHAR(64)        | SHA-256 over the SCD2 attribute set. Used by the merge proc. |

### dim_provider (SCD2)

| Column              | Type           | Notes |
|---------------------|----------------|-------|
| provider_sk         | BIGINT (PK)    |       |
| provider_bk         | VARCHAR(15)    | NPI. |
| full_name           | NVARCHAR(160)  |       |
| credential          | VARCHAR(20)    | `MD`, `DO`, `MBBS`, `PhD-MD`. |
| specialty           | NVARCHAR(80)   |       |
| primary_facility_sk | BIGINT (FK)    | -> dim_hospital. |
| license_expiry      | DATE           | Date the license expires. |
| hire_date           | DATE           |       |
| is_active           | BIT            |       |
| effective_from / effective_to / is_current / record_hash | SCD2 |  |

### dim_hospital

| Column        | Type        | Notes |
|---------------|-------------|-------|
| hospital_sk   | BIGINT (PK) |       |
| hospital_bk   | VARCHAR(20) | e.g. `HSP-CAI-01`, `CLN-ALX-05`. |
| hospital_name | NVARCHAR(150) |     |
| facility_type | VARCHAR(20) | `hospital` or `clinic`. |
| governorate, city | NVARCHAR(80) |  |
| bed_count     | INT         | 0 for clinics. |
| is_active     | BIT         |       |

### dim_payer / dim_diagnosis / dim_drug / dim_procedure

Small, code-driven. See [10_warehouse_schema.sql](../../sql/ddl/10_warehouse_schema.sql) for the full column list.

## Facts

### fact_encounter

Grain: **one row per encounter** (a single visit/admission).

| Column                | Type           | Notes |
|-----------------------|----------------|-------|
| encounter_sk          | BIGINT (PK)    |       |
| encounter_bk          | UNIQUEIDENTIFIER |     |
| patient_sk            | BIGINT (FK)    |       |
| provider_sk           | BIGINT (FK)    | Nullable - some encounters lack a provider. |
| hospital_sk           | BIGINT (FK)    |       |
| primary_diagnosis_sk  | BIGINT (FK)    | First-listed diagnosis. |
| start_date_sk, end_date_sk | INT (FK)  | -> dim_date. |
| encounter_class       | VARCHAR(30)    | `ambulatory`, `emergency`, `inpatient`, `wellness`. |
| length_of_stay_hours  | DECIMAL(10,2)  | `(end_at - start_at)` in hours; null for ongoing encounters. |
| base_cost_usd, total_cost_usd, payer_coverage_usd | DECIMAL(12,2) | From Synthea. |
| out_of_pocket_usd     | DECIMAL(12,2)  | `total_cost_usd - payer_coverage_usd`. |
| is_inpatient, is_emergency | BIT       | Derived from `encounter_class`. |
| is_readmission_30d    | BIT            | Derived in Silver via LAG over patient encounters. |
| discharge_status      | VARCHAR(40)    | `routine`, `expired`, `transfer`, `ama`. |
| silver_loaded_at, gold_loaded_at | DATETIME2 | Audit timestamps. |

### fact_claim

Grain: **one row per claim** (line items rolled up).

| Column                | Type            | Notes |
|-----------------------|-----------------|-------|
| claim_sk              | BIGINT (PK)     |       |
| claim_bk              | UNIQUEIDENTIFIER |     |
| claim_number          | VARCHAR(40)     | Human-readable, e.g. `CLM-2026-00012345`. |
| encounter_sk          | BIGINT (FK)     | **Nullable** - orphan claims allowed. |
| patient_sk, provider_sk, hospital_sk, payer_sk, primary_diagnosis_sk | BIGINT (FK) | All nullable. |
| service_date_sk, submission_date_sk, decision_date_sk | INT (FK) |  |
| days_to_decision      | INT             | Decision - submission. Null until decision. |
| status                | VARCHAR(30)     | `submitted`, `approved`, `denied`, `partially_paid`, `pending_review`. |
| is_denied             | BIT             | `status = denied`. |
| is_paid_in_full       | BIT             | `paid_amount = billed_amount`. |
| line_count            | INT             | Number of line items on the claim. |
| billed_amount         | DECIMAL(12,2)   | Sum of line items. |
| allowed_amount        | DECIMAL(12,2)   | Payer's allowed price. |
| paid_amount           | DECIMAL(12,2)   |       |
| denied_amount         | DECIMAL(12,2)   | `billed - allowed` when denied. |
| patient_responsibility| DECIMAL(12,2)   | What the patient owes. |
| currency              | CHAR(3)         | `EGP` for local; some legacy claims in `USD`. |

### fact_prescription

Grain: **one row per medication line on an encounter**.

| Column              | Type           | Notes |
|---------------------|----------------|-------|
| prescription_sk     | BIGINT (PK)    |       |
| encounter_sk        | BIGINT (FK)    | Nullable. |
| patient_sk          | BIGINT (FK)    |       |
| drug_sk             | BIGINT (FK)    |       |
| start_date_sk, stop_date_sk | INT (FK) |   |
| therapy_duration_days | INT          | `stop_date - start_date`; null if ongoing. |
| dispenses           | INT            | Number of fills. |
| total_cost_usd      | DECIMAL(12,2)  |       |

### fact_vital_signs_minute

Grain: **one row per device per minute**.

Streaming source - written by the Spark Structured Streaming job in append
mode, then mirrored to Synapse via `COPY INTO` once per hour.

| Column              | Type            | Notes |
|---------------------|-----------------|-------|
| vital_sk            | BIGINT (PK)     |       |
| patient_sk          | BIGINT (FK)     |       |
| hospital_sk         | BIGINT (FK)     |       |
| device_id           | VARCHAR(40)     | Bedside monitor identifier. |
| bed_number          | VARCHAR(10)     |       |
| minute_start_utc    | DATETIME2(0)    | Tumbling-window start. |
| date_sk             | INT (FK)        | Partition key. |
| sample_count        | INT             | Number of raw samples in the minute. |
| heart_rate_avg/min/max | DECIMAL(6,2) |       |
| spo2_avg/min        | DECIMAL(5,2)    |       |
| systolic_avg / diastolic_avg | DECIMAL(6,2) | |
| respiratory_rate_avg| DECIMAL(5,2)    |       |
| temperature_c_avg/max | DECIMAL(5,2) |       |
| anomaly_event_count | INT             | Count of raw samples flagged as anomalous. |
| primary_anomaly_kind| VARCHAR(40)     | Most-frequent anomaly kind in the minute. |

## Bridge tables

### bridge_encounter_diagnosis

Many-to-many between encounters and diagnoses. Each row tags the
diagnosis with `is_primary` (one row per encounter has it set) and a
`severity` from the source.

## Audit

### load_audit

| Column          | Type           | Notes |
|-----------------|----------------|-------|
| audit_id        | BIGINT (PK)    | Identity. |
| layer           | VARCHAR(20)    | `bronze`, `silver`, `gold`. |
| object_name     | VARCHAR(120)   | Table or proc name. |
| rows_read, rows_written, rows_rejected | BIGINT |  |
| started_at, finished_at | DATETIME2 |   |
| status          | VARCHAR(20)    | `success`, `failed`, `partial`. |
| error_message   | NVARCHAR(MAX)  |       |

## Reporting views

* `dw.vw_encounter_enriched` - fact_encounter + dim_patient + dim_hospital + dim_provider + dim_diagnosis pre-joined for Power BI.
* `dw.vw_claim_enriched` - similar treatment for fact_claim.
* `dw.vw_vital_signs_minute` - patient + hospital decoded for the streaming dashboard.

## Source-to-target lineage (high-level)

| Source feed              | Bronze object                | Silver object             | Gold target                       |
|--------------------------|------------------------------|---------------------------|-----------------------------------|
| Synthea `patients.csv`   | `bronze.synthea_patients`    | `silver.dim_patient`      | `dw.dim_patient`                  |
| Synthea `encounters.csv` | `bronze.synthea_encounters`  | `silver.fact_encounter`   | `dw.fact_encounter`               |
| Synthea `conditions.csv` | `bronze.synthea_conditions`  | `silver.bridge_diagnosis` | `dw.bridge_encounter_diagnosis`   |
| Synthea `medications.csv`| `bronze.synthea_medications` | `silver.fact_prescription`| `dw.fact_prescription`            |
| Synthea `procedures.csv` | `bronze.synthea_procedures`  | `silver.fact_procedure`   | (folded into `fact_encounter`)    |
| Provider API JSON        | `bronze.provider_registry`   | `silver.dim_provider`     | `dw.dim_provider`                 |
| Claims JSONL             | `bronze.claims_raw`          | `silver.fact_claim`       | `dw.fact_claim`                   |
| Vitals Event Hub stream  | `bronze.vitals_stream`       | `silver.vitals_minute`    | `dw.fact_vital_signs_minute`      |
